changelog:
- Initial release of GEO Optimizer Lite.
- Audit your content for AI search citability using the GEO Scorecard, covering 4 of 8 key dimensions.
- Provides page scores on Factual Density, Source Attribution, Structured Format, and Direct Answers.
- Offers actionable improvement suggestions based on your score.
- Includes a detailed scoring guide and explanation of GEO principles.
- Option to upgrade for full auditing and advanced features.
summary: Free version — audit your content for AI search citability with the GEO Scorecard. Covers 4 of 8 dimensions.
